title: 麗しきストレス発散法？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've been awfully busy lately. I know that's to be expected, since I'm training an Umamusume participating in the Twinkle Series, but even so…
choice_data_list: (I haven't even managed to tidy up…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's dust piling up in all four corners of my room. I don't have the energy to clean it up right now, though, so I head out to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You there! I apologize for the abrupt question, but may I have a moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You are Air Groove's trainer, are you not? I have something rather important to discuss, and I need someone I can trust.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll get straight to the point. Would cleaning your residence be a worthwhile task?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I understand your confusion, but this is a matter of extreme urgency. Please, answer me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll ask you once more… Would cleaning your residence be a worthwhile task?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Splendid! A good size—not too large, yet not too small. Enough space to be satisfactory, but not so much that it takes an unreasonable amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And most importantly, it belongs to someone trustworthy! I couldn't possibly hope for a better solution!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Will you give me five minutes? Just five minutes, and I'll have Air Groove ready at your place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you've already gathered, but she'll be cleaning your room! Wait for us there, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unsure of what's going on, I head back home and wait as per Symboli Rudolf's request.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The president gave me permission to clean your room. I'd like to get started right away, if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You can relax. This isn't charity. It's merely a personal matter, first and foremost.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll get started then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove pulls out a cloth and quietly begins wiping down the surfaces in my room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm… The place is far dustier than it looks. But not a speck shall escape me…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This should go without saying, but I am counting on you to keep today's events to yourself.
choice_data_list: Can you at least tell me what this is all about?
Can you at least tell me what this is all about?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes, my apologies. Allow me to explain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The student council has had to address a number of difficult affairs recently—affairs that have been causing us considerable mental strain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In other words, Air Groove has been extremely stressed as of late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I approached you because I thought you could provide a useful outlet for that stress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that black mold I see on the window frame? A simple cloth won't be enough to defeat you… Hehehe… Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh no, there's no place for compassion on the battlefield! Meet my secret weapon… baking soda!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove seems to be enjoying herself. …Maybe even a little too much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I was also surprised when I first saw her like this. It takes a lot for it to get this bad.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I stumbled upon her cleaning the floors of the student council office one day. Every last speck of dust—eradicated. It was quite the sight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Cleaning is an act that has palpable results, so I suppose it's easy to feel a sense of accomplishment from it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I questioned her about it afterward, but it appears that she retains little memory of the actual process.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Once again, I implore you not to tell anyone of this. My esteemed right hand's good name is at stake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's all very well, but it feels weird to just stand around and watch. Maybe I should…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh! A fine idea. Cleaning is a tiring business, after all. Allow me to join you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us head out to buy some snacks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I feel much better now. Thank you, President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And thank you as well for allowing me this opportunity, Trainer. By the way…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I didn't say anything… strange… while cleaning, did I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf shoots me a meaningful glance, so I shake my head fervently.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Y-you wish to talk to her while she's in this state?! Wh-what a novel idea! H-however, I…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh? You wish to enlist?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I like the cut of your jib! Very well, soldier. Take the sodium bicarbonate solution!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And you, President! Take that toothbrush!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: H-huh? I'm helping too?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Under the intense leadership of Air Groove, we all have an enjoyable clean-up session… or so I'd like to believe.
